command: set -euo pipefail; EXPECTED=19999bde451f068ee503d4b7c9a0a91712709c2a; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED"; test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"; IDF_ROOT="${HOME}/esp/esp-idf"; PARENT="$(dirname "$IDF_ROOT")"; TMP="${PARENT}/esp-idf.v5.5.4-fresh"; BACKUP="${PARENT}/esp-idf.pre-v5.5.4-backup"; test -d "$IDF_ROOT/.git"; test "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" remote get-url origin)" = 'https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf.git' || test "$(git -C "$IDF_ROOT" remote get-url origin)" = 'git@github.com:espressif/esp-idf.git'; rm -rf "$TMP"; test ! -e "$BACKUP"; git clone --branch v5.5.4 --single-branch https://github.com/espressif/esp-idf.git "$TMP"; git -C "$TMP" submodule sync --recursive; git -C "$TMP" submodule update --init --recursive; test "$(git -C "$TMP" describe --tags --exact-match HEAD)" = 'v5.5.4'; test -z "$(git -C "$TMP" status --porcelain --untracked-files=normal)"; printf 'FRESH_IDF_COMMIT=%s\n' "$(git -C "$TMP" rev-parse HEAD)"
